description: Enterprise-grade cloud CRM platform for managing sales, service, marketing, and custom business applications.
self_serve: self-serve free - Developer Edition free and API-enabled by default (plain Trial orgs are NOT API-enabled)
api_surface: very broad REST/SOAP/GraphQL (Connect REST, Bulk, Streaming); official MCP (Hosted MCP Servers GA Apr 2026, requires Enterprise Edition+)
blocker: none for basic use via free Developer Edition; hosted MCP needs Enterprise Edition+

description: All-in-one CRM with marketing, sales, service, and CMS hubs for inbound go-to-market teams.
auth_method: OAuth2 (public apps) or Private App access tokens
self_serve: self-serve free - API access on every plan including free tier, free developer test accounts
api_surface: broad REST (CRM objects, Marketing, CMS); official MCP (remote CRM MCP server + local Developer MCP server, GA)
blocker: none significant; rate limits scale with plan tier

description: Sales-pipeline-focused CRM for small and mid-sized sales teams.
auth_method: API token (x-api-token header) or OAuth2 (marketplace apps)
self_serve: self-serve trial - 14-day free trial with full API access, free dev sandbox account
api_surface: broad REST (deals, persons, orgs, activities); no confirmed official MCP server, only third-party listings
blocker: API call volume gated by daily token budget tied to plan/seats

description: Flexible, data-model-driven CRM aimed at startups and modern sales/ops teams.
auth_method: API key (Bearer, scoped) or OAuth2 (Authorization Code)
self_serve: self-serve free - API, webhooks, App SDK, MCP available on Free plan and up
api_surface: broad REST (objects, records, lists, workspace); official Attio-hosted MCP with OAuth one-click install

description: Open-source, self-hostable CRM alternative to Salesforce/HubSpot with a modern UI.
self_serve: self-serve free - fully free and self-hostable (AGPL-3.0); cloud plans start ~$9/user/mo with free tier
api_surface: broad auto-generated GraphQL (Core+Metadata) and REST CRUD; official MCP server ships with every Cloud workspace
blocker: self-hosting requires infra setup effort but no gating

description: Highly customizable work-management and database platform often used as a lightweight CRM, owned by Progress Software.
auth_method: OAuth2 (server-side, client-side, app auth, username/password flows)
self_serve: self-serve free - Free/Plus/Premium tiers, API free to use, 30-day Premium trial
api_surface: moderately broad REST-like API, rate-limited to 1,000 calls/hr; no evidence of official or notable community MCP server
blocker: aging platform, low rate limits, no MCP ecosystem, stagnant docs/community

description: Sales-focused CRM within the broader Zoho business-apps suite.
self_serve: self-serve free - free tier and self-service trial, API console self-service
api_surface: broad REST API v8 (modules, records, custom functions, bulk); official MCP at zoho.com/mcp plus community servers
blocker: OAuth scope model can be fiddly (per-module scopes) but not a hard blocker

description: Sales CRM built around built-in calling/email automation for inside-sales teams.
auth_method: API key (HTTP Basic) or OAuth2 (third-party apps)
self_serve: self-serve trial - 14-day free trial, no permanent free tier, paid plan required after (~$49/user/mo)
api_surface: broad REST API with interactive explorer; official native Close MCP server for ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor/n8n

description: CRM tightly integrated with Google Workspace, aimed at relationship-driven small/mid businesses.
auth_method: API key (token+email headers) or OAuth2 (partner integrations)
self_serve: self-serve trial - 14-day free trial; API access gated to Professional plan+ ($59+/seat/mo annually)
api_surface: broad REST Dev API (leads, people, companies, opportunities); no official first-party MCP, only third-party (Apideck, viaSocket)
blocker: API access requires upgrading past entry-level plan

description: Purpose-built deal, relationship, and pipeline management platform for private equity, investment banking, and corporate development firms.
self_serve: contact-sales gated - no free trial, enterprise-only sales-led onboarding (~$505K avg annual cost)
api_surface: broad REST Data/Management/Schema APIs; MCP in client preview, bundled only with 'DealCloud with Celeste' license
blocker: enterprise-only contact-sales pricing, no self-serve signup or trial
